name: Black Bean Penne Pasta with Mixed Vegetables

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and return to pot; set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
3 tomatoes
3 medium zucchini squash
⅓ kg cremini mushrooms
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Peel the carrots and onions. Slice carrots into ¼-inch rounds; slice onions in half and then into thin half moons. Transfer both to a medium bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms; add to the bowl with the carrot and onion.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into half rounds; add to the bowl with the veggies.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add veggies to the pot along with the garlic and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are crisp tender, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp basil
¾ tsp oregano
¾ tsp thyme
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, small dice the tomatoes and grate the Parmesean.
Shave leaves off the stems of the parsley; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
When the veggies are done, stir in the beans, diced tomatoes, half the parsley, oil, capers, and red wine vinegar; cook an additional 2 minutes. Reserve remaining parsley for garnish.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp capers
2 tbsp red wine vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Transfer vegetable mixture to the pot with the pasta and toss gently to combine.
To serve, divide the pasta mixture between plates; top with Parmesan and remaining parsley. Enjoy!
